reproduction: Make `/api/v1/billing/status` unavailable or return an error while RevenueCat customer info does not contain active `pro`.
Allow BillingGate.refresh() to continue after its inner billing-status catch.
Observe the derived plan and customer plan pill/product shell.
observed_result: The billing-status API error is silently swallowed.
Plan falls back to `evaluation` when local RevenueCat info does not prove Pro.
The customer can therefore be shown an Evaluation state even though server evaluation/expiry status was not verified.
expected_truth: Unable to verify server billing/evaluation status is UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE, never inferred as active Evaluation.
A known RevenueCat Pro entitlement may be shown as local/store evidence, but absence of Pro is not evidence of active Evaluation.
Protected API access remains server-authoritative and customer copy must distinguish verification failure from a valid plan state.
required_retest: PROVEN_AUTOMATED: billing-status failure cannot produce plan=evaluation solely from absence of Pro entitlement.
PROVEN_AUTOMATED: known expired server state remains expired even if local RevenueCat state is empty.
PROVEN_AUTOMATED: verified Evaluation state is rendered only from successful server evaluation evidence.
PROVEN_REAL_DEVICE: temporary backend billing-status outage is shown as verification unavailable, not an active Evaluation claim.
hard_boundary: Golden Path owns acceptance/regression only; Mobile Billing implementation repair remains with its specialist owner.
